title: Distinguish removable register-only barriers from required Venus2 vector-scratch visibility fences
proposed_rule: A vbarrier is not justified merely by adjacency of vector arithmetic or by vreturn. Remove register-only and terminal barriers as isolated candidates, then revalidate every visible output. Retain and classify a backend_workaround barrier when a vector scratch vstore is followed by a dependent vload on Venus2 unless a focused positive/negative Gem5 and RTL probe proves that exact dependency safe without the fence. vaddr scalar access keeps its existing vaddr_scalar_access barrier classification.
prompt: Classify every barrier before optimization. Is it guarding vaddr/VSPM scalar access, a measured vector-scratch store-to-load visibility boundary, or neither? Remove only one barrier class per candidate. Compare every pinned task output to the accepted baseline; a downstream final-output match alone is insufficient. Send only the correctness-qualified winner to fresh RTL.
scope: Venus2 C tasks with register-only vector dependencies, task returns, vaddr scalar access, or vector scratch store-to-dependent-load chains

positive_candidates.hypothesis: Remove register-only barriers in the four branch tasks; retain the vaddr scalar-access fence
Remove register-only MRC barriers; retain the metadata vaddr scalar-access fence
Remove barriers immediately before vreturn while retaining scalar-access fences

negative_counterexample.hypothesis: Remove every Polar barrier, including vector scratch store-to-dependent-load fences

integrated_winner.hypothesis: Remove Polar register-output and terminal barriers but retain named scratch visibility fences

implementation_proposal: Extend the static barrier gate to require one of vaddr_scalar_access or backend_workaround on every barrier or named wrapper
Recognize register-only vector dependency barriers and terminal-before-vreturn barriers as performance-search candidates, never as unconditional removals
Recognize Venus2 vector scratch vstore-to-dependent-vload chains as backend_workaround candidates requiring a focused counterexample receipt
Require all pinned intermediate outputs plus final golden outputs to pass after every barrier mutation
Require the integrated winner to pass fresh immutable-RTL validation before accepting the workload optimization
validation_before_promotion: Replay the accepted C005 positive case and the C004 negative counterexample from immutable artifacts
Add at least one reduced scratch dependency probe and one independent workload or Polar shape
Run Gem5 fast, Gem5 verification, and fresh RTL for each promoted positive case
Bind human acceptance to this proposal digest, the shadow patch digest, and the frozen base knowledge digests
promotion_gate: REVIEW_REQUIRED; this proposal does not edit live knowledge and cannot self-promote
rollback: Remove the proposed static classification/search rule. The qualified CCH workload remains valid because its retained scratch fences and immutable RTL receipt are independent evidence.
